title: Mind the Gap: How SBOM Specification Ambiguities Lead to Divergent Software Bills of Materials. An Empirical Tool Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.19920v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Software Bill of Materials (SBOMs) will become mandatory starting in December 2027 under the European Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) [8]. Although previous studies have highlighted significant differences among SBOM generators, the reasons for these discrepancies remain unknown, as does whether they stem from implementation errors or deliberate design choices.  In this paper, we evaluate three widely used SBOM generators across more than 3,000 JavaScript and Rust projects, using a groundtruth baseline derived from dependency lockfiles.  Our results show that these tools diverge in terms of both dependency coverage and SBOM completeness. translated_title: 注意差距：SBOM规范歧义如何导致软件物料清单的分歧——一项实证工具研究
translated_abstract: 根据欧盟《网络弹性法案》（CRA），软件物料清单（SBOM）将从2027年12月起成为强制要求。尽管先前的研究已经指出了SBOM生成器之间存在显著差异，但这些差异产生的原因仍然未知，它们究竟源于实现错误还是有意的设计选择也不得而知。在本文中，我们基于从依赖锁文件中获取的真实基准，在3000多个JavaScript和Rust项目上评估了三个广泛使用的SBOM生成器。我们的结果表明，这些工具在依赖覆盖率和SBOM完整性方面均存在差异。重要的是，这些差异大多是系统性的而非偶然的：它们源于对依赖范围、命名、来源和表示方式的不同假设，而另一些差异则反映了对SBOM规范中定义的字段支持的不一致性。这些发现表明，许多
tldr: 该研究通过对3000多个JavaScript和Rust项目的实证分析发现，主流SBOM生成器之间的差异主要是系统性的，源于SBOM规范中关于依赖范围、命名、来源和表示方式的歧义所导致的解释分歧，而非实现错误。
en_tdlr: This empirical study of over 3,000 JavaScript and Rust projects reveals that divergences among mainstream SBOM generators are mostly systematic, arising from different interpretations of ambiguous SBOM specifications regarding dependency scope, naming, provenance, and representation, rather than implementation errors.
